graph.title: LEGO 7246-1 Mini Digger (page 1: steps 1-7)
notes: Page 1 shows the minifigure (not in the parts list, so not recorded) and steps 1-7. Step 8 (model flipped, two dark 2x2 bricks and a black 2x2 plate visible) was too ambiguous to place and is left for the next pages.
Steps 4-6 are drawn upside down/rotated, so exact placement of the three grille tiles, red plates, clip plate, hinge plate and 4x1 bar is inferred. All are recorded as resting on the yellow base b3.
Step 5 black clip plate (b9) is the one at the rear between the trans-red plates; the second clip plate is not seen yet.
Piece colours follow the parts list (grille tiles shown as black in the picture but listed Dark Bluish Gray).
Step 7: yellow hinge brick b14 is clicked on the hinge fingers of hinge plate b10.

Step 8 from page 1 is added here: two 2x2 bricks (b15, b16) with a black 2x2 plate (b17) between them are fitted across the underside of the 2x6 plate b1 (6 studs = 2+2+2). Placement is inferred from the flipped view.
Step 9: the two wheel-holder plates (b18, b19) go on the bricks b15 and b16.
Step 10: the bucket b20 is hinged on the yellow hinge brick b14 (the second hinge finger set, hinge.2). The steering stand b21 sits at the front of the seat, on the base b3.

Step 11: the 4 wheels with tyres go on the wheel holders, two per holder. The second clip plate (b30) and the trans-orange cone (b31) are placed on the studs of the black arch b11 at the rear. The shovel (b32) and jackhammer (b33) are clipped to the two clip plates. The picture is small, so exact stud/clip assignments are guesses.
The minifigure and its hard hat are not in the parts list and are not recorded. It sits on the seat in step 11.
